name: Spontaneous Healer

other: Able to cast any cure wounds spell

benefit: You can use your spellcasting ability to spontaneously cast cure spells (from your class spell list), just as a cleric can. You may use this ability a total number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier.
note: The printed benefit is a limited-uses-per-day spontaneous cast (Wis modifier times/day), which reads as an unlimited substitute-any-prepared-spell-for-a-Cure-spell effect elsewhere in this project (CLAUDE.md, src/data/feats/spontaneous_healer.json) — Rae has confirmed this is fine as-is: Lyra's Wisdom modifier is high (and rising), so the daily cap isn't a practical constraint, and the DM has ruled that cure minor wounds (the orison) doesn't draw against this limit at all. No app change needed.
